Name: Saturation Doom Loop
Pathway: Traditional employment stress → Workers flee TO gig → Oversupply → Earnings decline → Hours increase → Financial stress → Auto loan DQ → Economic contraction → More employment stress
Mechanism: Reinforcing feedback loop. Gig economy cannot absorb unlimited supply—saturation compresses earnings for ALL workers.
Feedback Loops: Self-reinforcing: more entrants → lower earnings → more stress → economic contraction → more entrants
Breakpoint: Gig earnings fall below subsistence for full-time workers

Name: Vehicle Asset Cascade
Pathway: Gig earnings decline → Deferred maintenance → Accelerated depreciation → Underwater on loan → Miss payments OR exit gig → Auto default OR income loss
Mechanism: Vehicles are both productive asset and liability. High-mileage use accelerates depreciation faster than loan paydown.
Feedback Loops: Exit reduces income, which increases loan stress
Breakpoint: Widespread negative equity in gig worker vehicles

Name: Platform Rationalization
Pathway: Profitability pressure → Reduce incentives/raise take rates → Earnings decline → Best workers exit → Service quality declines → Customer demand declines → More pressure
Mechanism: Investor pressure forces extraction from workers. Triggers adverse selection—best workers with alternatives leave first.
Feedback Loops: Quality decline → demand decline → revenue pressure → more cuts

Name: Gig-to-CARL Transmission
Pathway: Gig worker stress → Spending contraction → Credit utilization increase → Auto loan stress → Broader consumer credit deterioration → CARL vectors trigger
Mechanism: Gig workers are ~5-10% of labor force but leading indicator. Stress transmits through spending, credit, auto, and sentiment.
Feedback Loops: Credit stress limits spending recovery options
Breakpoint: Gig stress visible in CARL credit metrics
